type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (M : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model N) (hDVR : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PlacesDiscrete M)
  (f : ↥M.K),
  Transcendental ℚ f →
    AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.divisorDegree M
          (AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.functionZeroDivisor M hDVR f) =
        ↑(Module.finrank ↥ℚ⟮f⟯ ↥M.K) ∧
      AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.divisorDegree M
          (AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.functionPoleDivisor M hDVR f) =
        ↑(Module.finrank ↥ℚ⟮f⟯ ↥M.K)
name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.functionZeroPoleDegrees

type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (M : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model N) (hDVR : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PlacesDiscrete M)
  (A : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Divisor M),
  ∃ (z : ↥M.K),
    z ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ (l : ℕ),
        A + AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.functionDivisor M hDVR z ≤
          l • AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.functionPoleDivisor M hDVR M.u
name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannPolarApproximation

type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (M : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model N) (hDVR : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PlacesDiscrete M),
  (∀ (A : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Divisor M),
      FiniteDimensional ℚ ↥(AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannRochSpace M hDVR A)) →
    ∀ (l : ℕ),
      (l + 1) * N ≤
        AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannEll M hDVR
          (l • AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.functionPoleDivisor M hDVR M.u +
            AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.basisPoleCorrection M hDVR)
name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannBasisPowerLowerBound

type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (M : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model N) (hDVR : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PlacesDiscrete M)
  (A : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Divisor M),
  FiniteDimensional ℚ ↥(AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannRochSpace M hDVR A)
name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannRochFiniteDimensional

type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (M : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model N) (hDVR : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PlacesDiscrete M)
  (A : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Divisor M),
  ↑(AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannEll M hDVR A) ≤
    Max.max 0
      (AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.divisorDegree M A + ↑(AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannEll M hDVR 0))
name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannRochDimensionUpperBound

type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (M : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model N) (hDVR : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PlacesDiscrete M),
  ∃ (g0 : ℤ) (N0 : ℤ),
    ∀ (A : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Divisor M),
      N0 ≤ AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.divisorDegree M A →
        ↑(AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannEll M hDVR A) =
          AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.divisorDegree M A - g0
name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannRochEventuallyLinear
